## Salary coverage

Share of minutes played by players with a known salary.

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from _viz import show, read, LEAGUE, line
s = read("step1_salary_coverage.csv")
fig = go.Figure()
for lg, col in LEAGUE.items():
    d = s[s.league == lg]
    line(fig, d.season, d.minutes_weighted_matched, lg, col, hovertemplate=lg + ": %{y:.0%}<extra></extra>")
fig.update_layout(height=360, yaxis=dict(tickformat=".0%", range=[0, 1.02]))
show(fig)
```
